```text
## Known API facts and quirks

Platform behaviour learned the hard way, with citations — including disproofs of anything in
`AGENTS.md`, `agents/rules/**` or `students.md` (R5: record the disproof, name the file and
line it corrects).

- **CI is label- and path-gated.** A docs/Markdown-only PR runs no checks and `required` still
  passes; without `ready-for-e2e` no build or e2e job runs at all — `.github/workflows/pr.yml`,
  verified 2026-09-14.
- **`yarn test` does not run the timezone project.** CI runs the suite a second time with
  `VITEST_MODE=timezone`; the selection happens at `vitest.workspace.ts:7` — verified
  2026-09-14.
- **Next.js is 16.2.3, not 14.** `apps/web/package.json` `dependencies.next` = `16.2.3`,
  verified 2026-09-14. This **disproves** `students.md` ("Next.js 14", with a link to the
  Next 14 docs) and `AGENTS.md` §Tech Stack ("Next.js 13+"). Both are stale; neither is ours
  to edit (R13). Treat any framework-version claim in those two files as a lead only (R3).
- **API v2 is NestJS** — `apps/api/v2/package.json` depends on `@nestjs/common` et al.,
  verified 2026-09-14.
- **Correction: a database *is* possible here.** This file previously said no DB-backed work
  could run because Docker is absent. Homebrew has `postgresql@14` (14.18) installed with
  `postgres`, `pg_ctl` and `initdb` on PATH — it is simply not started, and nothing is listening
  on the `.env` default port 5450. So **D1 (run the app locally) is achievable** without Docker;
  it needs Postgres started, the `calendso` database created, migrations applied and a seed.
  Verified 2026-09-14.
- **`docs/sprint0/standards.md` is @lexzach's (Zachary Bowden), on his open WIP PR #7.** It is a
  shared team deliverable (D3, one per team), so changes belong there as review suggestions or
  Zulip coordination — **do not push to that branch**. A drafted Definition of Done plus the two
  conflict fixes are in `docs/agent/proposed-definition-of-done.md` (private, uncommitted).
- **The team's standards exist, unmerged, on PR #7.** `docs/sprint0/standards.md` on branch
  `docs/standards-guidelines` (opened 2026-09-13, still titled `WIP:`) covers branch names
  (`docs|feat|fix`/`name`), commit names (present tense, `Add …`), PR process, testing
  expectations, AI tool use and a **Definition of Done heading with no content**. It says
  nothing about AI-log links. Verified 2026-09-14 — and because it is `WIP:`, its own rule says
  it is not to be reviewed for merging, so **none of it binds yet**. Three conflicts with rules
  live on `main` are recorded in `docs/AGENT-PRACTICES.md` §Posture.
- **Branch `short` does not match the proposed branch convention** (`docs|feat|fix`/`name`).
  Harmless while PR #7 is unmerged, but a future branch should be e.g. `docs/agent-standard`.
- **The AI-log deliverable has a documented shape** (`ai-logs/README.md`, tracked, added in
  `02e09b9cb3`): `ai-logs/sprint<N>/<github-username>/YYYY-MM-DD_<tool>_<short-description>.md`,
  with a sibling directory of the same name for attachments; the tool id for this tool is
  `claude-code`. **But the instructions it defers to do not exist**: it links
  `docs/sprints.md#d4--ai-tooling-setup`, and `docs/sprints.md` is on no ref (verified
  2026-09-14, `git log --all --diff-filter=A -- docs/sprints.md`); the relative path in that
  link (`../../docs/`) also points above the repo root. **Correction to this file's earlier
  claim** that the repo documented no course conventions: it does, and the grep that "proved"
  otherwise searched for words the file does not contain (R4).
- **`yarn build` writes to your database. It is not read-only.** `packages/prisma`'s build
  script is `ts-node --transpile-only ./auto-migrations.ts`, and `auto-migrations.ts:34` runs
  **`yarn prisma migrate deploy`** against whatever `DATABASE_URL` is set to. `CONTRIBUTING.md`
  §Building tells every contributor to run `yarn build` before pushing, and says nothing about
  this. **Never run `yarn build` with `.env` pointed at a shared, staging or production
  database** — it will apply pending migrations to it.
- **`yarn build`'s "no database, skip gracefully" guard does not work.**
  `auto-migrations.ts` intends to skip when the DB is absent, but
  `is-prisma-available-check.ts` returns `false` only for `Prisma.PrismaClientInitializationError`
  and **rethrows every other error**. A refused connection to a Postgres that is not running is
  not that class, so it escapes the guard, reaches `main().catch()` and exits 1. Net effect on a
  machine with no Docker: the documented pre-push command **fails in 20s** at
  `@calcom/prisma#build` with ``Invalid `prisma.$queryRaw()` invocation``, and the failure looks
  like a code problem when it is an environment one. Escape hatch: `SKIP_DB_MIGRATIONS=1`
  (`auto-migrations.ts:17`). Verified 2026-09-14.
- **A nested worktree doubles the test suite and turns it red — measured.** With a worktree at
  `.claude/worktrees/`, `TZ=UTC yarn test` from the primary checkout reported **830 files (208
  failed) / 6323 tests (38 failed), exit 1**. The identical tree with `--exclude '**/.claude/**'`
  reported **406 files (0 failed) / 4119 tests (0 failed), exit 0**. All 208 "failures" were
  duplicate copies, 202 of them `(0 test)` import errors because the nested checkout has source
  but no `node_modules`. `vitest list` also exits 1 in that state. Verified 2026-09-14.
  **Check `git worktree list` before trusting a test count.**
- **`CLAUDE.local.md` IS loaded by this harness.** Confirmed 2026-09-14: a session restart
  re-read instruction files and listed `/Users/zachshort/Projects/cal.diy/CLAUDE.local.md` as
  "user's private project instructions, not checked in". The private router works where it is;
  it does not need to move into `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`.
- **`yarn lint` is turbo-cached and the documented command has no `--force`** — it can print
  `>>> FULL TURBO` having executed nothing. Use `yarn lint --force` when the number matters.
  See §Environment. Verified 2026-09-14.
- **Nested worktrees live inside the repo.** Claude Code puts them at
  `.claude/worktrees/<name>/`, i.e. *inside* `~/Projects/cal.diy`. Git ignores that path
  (`.git/info/exclude`), but tools that glob the filesystem do not necessarily. Test output on
  2026-09-14 showed vitest reporting files under `.claude/worktrees/.../apps/...` while running
  from the primary checkout. `type-check` and `lint` are **not** affected — turbo scopes them to
  the `workspaces` globs in `package.json` (`apps/*`, `packages/*`, ...), none of which match
  `.claude/worktrees/**`.
- **`turbo run type-check:ci` replays cached results**; `--force` is why `AGENTS.md` prescribes
  it.
- **`Security Audit / audit` fails on every non-docs PR, and it is `main`'s dependency tree, not
  yours.** Verified 2026-09-15 on PRs #20 and #21, which fail it identically.
  `.github/workflows/security-audit.yml` runs `yarn npm audit --all --recursive --severity critical`
  as a hard gate, and the tree carries **six critical advisories**: Next.js unauthenticated RCE on
  Windows-hosted servers (×2), Next.js unauthenticated RCE in the Image Optimization API via AVIF
  (×2), Auth.js homoglyph `@` bypass in the email normalizer, node-tar decompression DoS, and
  websocket-driver message corruption. **Neither PR touches `package.json` or `yarn.lock`**
  (`git diff --name-only origin/main..<branch> | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|yarn\.lock)$'` →
  nothing), and `yarn npm audit` derives its entire result from that tree, so each PR's audit
  result is identical to what its parent commit on `main` would produce. **It cannot be observed
  failing on `main` directly**: the workflow is `on: workflow_call` only, so it runs from `pr.yml`
  and never on a push to `main` — which is why nobody had seen this red before. A docs-only PR
  skips it entirely (PR #7 shows `Security Audit  skipping`). Do not try to fix it inside a
  feature PR; it needs a dependency bump of its own.
- **`required` fails by design when e2e is skipped, and that is most PRs.** On #20 and #21
  everything substantive passes — `Linters / lint`, `Tests / Unit`, `Tests / API v2 Unit`,
  `Type Checks / check-types`, `Prepare`, `Trust Check`, `Validate PR title` — while
  `Analyze Build`, `Production builds`, `Tests`, `Setup Database` and `Check Prisma Migrations`
  all report `skipping` for want of the `ready-for-e2e` label, and `required` then fails in 3–4s.
  Verified 2026-09-15.
```

```text
**8. Fixed issue #10 — the save button was innocent.** Done 2026-09-14/15, worktree
`dazzling-blackburn-d0ed04`, branch `fix/issue-10-save-button-no-changes` off `origin/main`.
Zach located the code himself (D5 rule honoured): he named `EventTypeLayout.tsx`, then
"`EventTypeSingleLayout` or wherever `useForm` is called". First half was the same file —
`EventTypeSingleLayout` is declared *inside* `EventTypeLayout.tsx:52` and exported at `:331` —
second half was right: `useEventTypeForm.ts:141`.

**The finding that mattered: the save button already had the fix.**
`EventTypeLayout.tsx:279` has carried `disabled={!formMethods.formState.isDirty}` all along, and
`Button.tsx:242`/`:353` honour it. The form was genuinely dirty on load. Read out of React's
fiber tree on the running app: `dirtyFields: { description: true }`, `defaultValues.description
= undefined`, live value `""`.

**Cause.** The Lexical editor calls `setText` **twice** while mounting (measured: two emissions
~48ms apart, identical values), echoing back the value it was just seeded with —
`ToolbarPlugin.tsx:386` seeds inside a mount `useEffect`, and `:410` registers the update
listener inside that same `editor.update`, so the listener fires on its own seeding update.
`EventSetupTab.tsx:157` wrote that echo in with `{ shouldDirty: true }`.

**Second, worse bug, not in the issue text:** `md.render` → `turndown` is lossy, so the echo
often *differs* from what is stored. Proven live by temporarily setting
`description = '**bold** and _italic_'` on event type 12: the form loaded holding
`****bold**** and _italic_`. Since `handleSubmit` builds its payload from `dirtyValues`
(`useEventTypeForm.ts:320`, `:410`) and description *was* dirty, **saving an untouched event
type persisted the mangled text.** The DB row was reverted to `NULL` after the test.

**Two dead ends worth not repeating.** (a) `{ shouldDirty: false }` does **not** fix this —
react-hook-form derives `formState.isDirty` by deep-comparing `_formValues` to `_defaultValues`
independently of the flag, so `dirtyFields` went empty while `isDirty` stayed `true`. The guard
must skip the **write**, not the flag. (b) A single-shot "first emission" guard fails, because
there are two mount emissions; the guard must compare against the first emitted *value*.

**Shipped:** new `apps/web/modules/event-types/components/tabs/setup/description-editor-guard.ts`
(remembers the first emitted value, treats equal values as echoes, latches on the first
difference so a later clear-back-to-echo is still written) + its 7-case test, wired into
`EventSetupTab.tsx`, plus `useEventTypeForm.ts` `description: … ?? undefined` → `?? ""` so
emptying a never-described event type returns to genuinely clean. 2 files changed (+7/−2), 2 new.

1m36s); lint exit 0 (11 tasks, 0 cached, **3972 files**, 6092 warnings / 13145 infos / **0
```

```text
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+/**
+ * The Lexical editor behind the event type description calls `setText` twice while it mounts,
+ * echoing back the value it was just seeded with. Writing that echo into the form is what let
+ * users save an event type they had not touched: `md.render` -> `turndown` is lossy, so the echo
+ * can differ from what is stored ("**bold**" comes back as "****bold****"), react-hook-form then
+ * sees the form as changed, and the next save wrote the mangled text to the database.
+ *
+ * This guard answers one question per emission: is this the user editing, or the editor echoing?
+ * It latches on the first differing value so that every later emission is treated as an edit -
+ * including clearing the field back to the echoed text, which must still be saved.
+ *
+ * See https://github.com/CSCI-435-SE/cal.diy/issues/10
+ */
+export function createDescriptionEditorGuard(): (markdownValue: string) => boolean {
+  let mountEcho: string | null = null;
+  let hasUserEdited = false;
+
+  return function isUserEdit(markdownValue: string): boolean {
+    if (hasUserEdited) return true;
+
+    if (mountEcho === null) {
+      mountEcho = markdownValue;
+    }
+    if (markdownValue === mountEcho) return false;
+
+    hasUserEdited = true;
+    return true;
+  };
+}
```

```text
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import type { Dispatch, SetStateAction } from "react";
import type { MutableRefObject } from "react";

import { Dialog } from "@calcom/features/components/controlled-dialog";
import { useLocale } from "@calcom/lib/hooks/useLocale";
import { Button } from "@calcom/ui/components/button";
import { DialogContent, DialogFooter } from "@calcom/ui/components/dialog";

interface AssignmentWarningDialogProps {
  isOpenAssignmentWarnDialog: boolean;
  setIsOpenAssignmentWarnDialog: Dispatch<SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  pendingRoute: string;
  leaveWithoutAssigningHosts: MutableRefObject<boolean>;
  id: number;
}

const AssignmentWarningDialog = (props: AssignmentWarningDialogProps) => {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const {
    isOpenAssignmentWarnDialog,
    setIsOpenAssignmentWarnDialog,
    pendingRoute,
    leaveWithoutAssigningHosts,
    id,
  } = props;
  const router = useRouter();
  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpenAssignmentWarnDialog} onOpenChange={setIsOpenAssignmentWarnDialog}>
      <DialogContent
        title={t("leave_without_assigning_anyone")}
        description={`${t("leave_without_adding_attendees")} ${t("no_availability_shown_to_bookers")}`}
        Icon="circle-alert"
        enableOverflow
        type="confirmation">
        <DialogFooter className="mt-6">
          <Button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              setIsOpenAssignmentWarnDialog(false);
              router.replace(`/event-types/${id}?tabName=team`);
            }}
            color="minimal">
            {t("go_back_and_assign")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              setIsOpenAssignmentWarnDialog(false);
              leaveWithoutAssigningHosts.current = true;
              router.replace(pendingRoute);
            }}>
            {t("leave_without_assigning")}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
};
export default AssignmentWarningDialog;
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
    52	      const paths = url.split("/");

    57	      if (
    58	        !!isTeamEventType &&

    64	          assignAllTeamMembers,
    65	          isManagedEventType,

    71	    onStart?.(handleRouteChange);
    72	    return () => {
    73	      onEnd?.(handleRouteChange);
    74	    };
    75	    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    76	  }, [watchTrigger, hosts, assignedUsers, assignAllTeamMembers, onError, onStart, onEnd]);
```

```text
     1	import type { ReactElement, Ref } from "react";

     4	import { FormProvider } from "react-hook-form";

     7	
     8	import { showToast } from "../../toast";

    10	type FormProps<T extends object> = { form: UseFormReturn<T>; handleSubmit: SubmitHandler<T> } & Omit<
    11	  JSX.IntrinsicElements["form"],
    12	  "onSubmit"
    13	>;
    14	
    15	const PlainForm = <T extends FieldValues>(props: FormProps<T>, ref: Ref<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    16	  const { form, handleSubmit, ...passThrough } = props;
    17	
    18	  return (
    19	    <FormProvider {...form}>
    20	      <form
    21	        ref={ref}
    22	        onSubmit={(event) => {

    26	          form

    30	              showToast(`${getErrorFromUnknown(err).message}`, "error");
    31	            });
    32	        }}
    33	        {...passThrough}>
    34	        {props.children}
```

```text
export function ShellMain(props: LayoutProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isLocaleReady } = useLocale();

  return (
    <>
      {(props.heading || !!props.backPath) && (
        <div
          className={classNames(
            "bg-default mb-0 flex items-center md:mb-6 md:mt-0",
            props.smallHeading ? "lg:mb-7" : "lg:mb-8",
            !props.disableSticky && "sticky top-0 z-10"
          )}>
          {!!props.backPath && (
            <Button
              variant="icon"
              size="sm"
              color="minimal"
              onClick={() =>
                typeof props.backPath === "string" ? router.push(props.backPath as string) : router.back()
              }
              StartIcon="arrow-left"
              aria-label="Go Back"
              className="rounded-md ltr:mr-2 rtl:ml-2"
              data-testid="go-back-button"
            />
          )}
          {props.heading && (
            <header
              className={classNames(props.large && "py-8", "flex w-full max-w-full items-center truncate")}>
              {props.HeadingLeftIcon && <div className="ltr:mr-4">{props.HeadingLeftIcon}</div>}
              <div
                className={classNames("w-full truncate ltr:mr-4 rtl:ml-4 md:block", props.headerClassName)}>
                {props.heading && (
                  <h3
                    className={classNames(
                      "font-cal text-emphasis max-w-28 sm:max-w-72 md:max-w-80 hidden truncate text-lg font-semibold tracking-wide sm:text-xl md:block xl:max-w-full",
                      props.smallHeading ? "text-base" : "text-xl"
                    )}>
                    {!isLocaleReady ? <SkeletonText invisible /> : props.heading}
                  </h3>
                )}
                {props.subtitle && (
                  <p className="text-default hidden text-sm md:block" data-testid="subtitle">
                    {!isLocaleReady ? <SkeletonText invisible /> : props.subtitle}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
              {props.beforeCTAactions}
              {props.CTA && (
                <div
                  className={classNames(
                    props.backPath
                      ? "relative"
                      : "pwa:bottom-[max(7rem,_calc(5rem_+_env(safe-area-inset-bottom)))] fixed bottom-20 z-40 ltr:right-4 rtl:left-4 md:z-auto md:ltr:right-0 md:rtl:left-0",

      <div className={classNames(props.flexChildrenContainer && "flex flex-1 flex-col")}>
        {props.children}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```text
    </KBarWrapper>
```

```text
import * as DialogPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-dialog";
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
import type { ForwardRefExoticComponent, ReactNode } from "react";
import React from "react";

import { useLocale } from "@calcom/lib/hooks/useLocale";
import classNames from "@calcom/ui/classNames";

import type { ButtonProps } from "../button";
import { Button } from "../button";
import type { IconName } from "../icon";
import { Icon } from "../icon";

const dialogClasses = cva(
  "fadeIn bg-default scroll-bar fixed left-1/2 top-1/2 z-50 w-[95vw] m-auto -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-2xl text-left shadow-xl focus-visible:outline-none sm:align-middle",
  {
    variants: {
      size: {
        xl: "px-8 pt-8 sm:max-w-360",
        lg: "px-8 pt-8 sm:max-w-280",
        md: "px-8 pt-8 sm:max-w-3xl",
        default: "px-8 pt-8 sm:max-w-140",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      size: "default",
    },
  }
);

export type DialogProps = React.ComponentProps<(typeof DialogPrimitive)["Root"]>;

export function Dialog(props: DialogProps) {
  const { children, ...dialogProps } = props;
  return <DialogPrimitive.Root {...dialogProps}>{children}</DialogPrimitive.Root>;
}

type DialogContentProps = React.ComponentProps<(typeof DialogPrimitive)["Content"]> & {
  type?: "creation" | "confirmation";
  title?: string;
  description?: string | JSX.Element | null;
  closeText?: string;
  actionDisabled?: boolean;
  Icon?: IconName;
  enableOverflow?: boolean;
  forceOverlayWhenNoModal?: boolean;
  /**
   * Disables the ability to close the dialog by clicking outside of it. Could be useful when the dialog is doing something critical which might be in progress.
   */
  preventCloseOnOutsideClick?: boolean;
} & VariantProps<typeof dialogClasses>;

// enableOverflow:- use this prop whenever content inside DialogContent could overflow and require scrollbar
export const DialogContent = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DialogContentProps>(
  (
    {
      children,
      title,
      Icon: icon,
      enableOverflow,
      forceOverlayWhenNoModal,
      type = "creation",
      preventCloseOnOutsideClick,
      ...props
    },
    forwardedRef
  ) => {
    return (
      <DialogPrimitive.Portal>
        {forceOverlayWhenNoModal ? (
          <div className="fadeIn fixed inset-0 z-50  bg-neutral-800/70 transition-opacity" />
        ) : (
          <DialogPrimitive.Overlay className="fadeIn fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-neutral-800/70 transition-opacity dark:bg-neutral-800/80" />
        )}
        <DialogPrimitive.Content
          {...props}
          onPointerDownOutside={(e) => {
            if (preventCloseOnOutsideClick) {
              e.preventDefault();
            }
          }}
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          className={classNames(
            dialogClasses({ size: props.size }),
            "max-h-[95vh]",
            enableOverflow ? "overflow-y-auto" : "overflow-visible",
            `${props.className || ""}`
          )}
          ref={forwardedRef}>
          {type === "creation" && (
            <div>
              <DialogHeader title={title} subtitle={props.description} />
              <div data-testid="dialog-creation" className="flex flex-col">
                {children}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {type === "confirmation" && (
            <div>
              <DialogHeader title={title} subtitle={props.description} icon={icon} />
              <div data-testid="dialog-confirmation" className="flex flex-col">
                {children}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {!type && children}
        </DialogPrimitive.Content>
      </DialogPrimitive.Portal>
    );
  }
);

type DialogHeaderProps = {
  title: React.ReactNode;
  subtitle?: React.ReactNode;
  icon?: IconName;
} & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>;

export function DialogFooter(props: DialogFooterProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className={classNames(
        "bg-cal-muted border-muted bottom-0 -mx-8 mt-10 rounded-b-2xl border",
        props?.noSticky ? "" : "sticky",
        props.className
      )}>
      {props.showDivider && <div data-testid="divider" className="border-subtle border-t" />}
      <div className={classNames("flex justify-end space-x-2 px-8 py-4 font-sans rtl:space-x-reverse")}>
        {props.children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

DialogContent.displayName = "DialogContent";

export const DialogTrigger: ForwardRefExoticComponent<
  DialogPrimitive.DialogTriggerProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>
> = React.forwardRef((props, ref) => {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Trigger {...props} ref={ref} />;
});

DialogTrigger.displayName = "DialogTrigger";

export function DialogClose(
  props: {
    "data-testid"?: string;
    dialogCloseProps?: React.ComponentProps<(typeof DialogPrimitive)["Close"]>;
    children?: ReactNode;
    onClick?: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent>) => void;
    disabled?: boolean;
    color?: ButtonProps["color"];
  } & React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>
) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const { className, ...buttonProps } = props;

  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Close asChild {...props.dialogCloseProps}>
      <Button
        data-testid={props["data-testid"] || "dialog-rejection"}
        color={props.color || "minimal"}
        className={classNames(props.color === "destructive" && "destructive", className)}
        {...buttonProps}>
        {props.children ? props.children : t("close")}
      </Button>
    </DialogPrimitive.Close>
  );
}
```

```text
import * as DialogPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-dialog";
import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";

import { useIsPlatform } from "@calcom/atoms/hooks/useIsPlatform";
import { useCompatSearchParams } from "@calcom/lib/hooks/useCompatSearchParams";
import { Dialog as BaseDialog } from "@calcom/ui/components/dialog";

export type DialogProps = React.ComponentProps<(typeof DialogPrimitive)["Root"]> & {
  name?: string;
  clearQueryParamsOnClose?: string[];
};

const enum DIALOG_STATE {
  // Dialog is there in the DOM but not visible.
  CLOSED = "CLOSED",
  // State from the time b/w the Dialog is dismissed and the time the "dialog" query param is removed from the URL.
  CLOSING = "CLOSING",
  // Dialog is visible.
  OPEN = "OPEN",
}

export function Dialog(props: DialogProps) {
  const isPlatform = useIsPlatform();
  return !isPlatform ? <ControlledDialog {...props} /> : <DialogPrimitive.Dialog {...props} />;
}

function ControlledDialog(props: DialogProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useCompatSearchParams();
  const newSearchParams = new URLSearchParams(searchParams.toString());
  const { children, name, ...dialogProps } = props;

  // only used if name is set
  const [dialogState, setDialogState] = useState(dialogProps.open ? DIALOG_STATE.OPEN : DIALOG_STATE.CLOSED);
  const shouldOpenDialog = newSearchParams.get("dialog") === name;
  if (name) {
    const clearQueryParamsOnClose = ["dialog", ...(props.clearQueryParamsOnClose || [])];
    dialogProps.onOpenChange = (open) => {
      if (props.onOpenChange) {
        props.onOpenChange(open);
      }

      // toggles "dialog" query param
      if (open) {
        newSearchParams.set("dialog", name);
      } else {
        clearQueryParamsOnClose.forEach((queryParam) => {
          newSearchParams.delete(queryParam);
        });
        router.push(`${pathname}?${newSearchParams.toString()}`);
      }
      setDialogState(open ? DIALOG_STATE.OPEN : DIALOG_STATE.CLOSING);
    };

    if (dialogState === DIALOG_STATE.CLOSED && shouldOpenDialog) {
      setDialogState(DIALOG_STATE.OPEN);
    }
```

<tool-use data-tool-type="generic" data-tool-name="AskUserQuestion"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **AskUserQuestion**</summary>
**Issue #9 open question: should the browser Back button open the unsaved-changes dialog?**

Options:
- **No, links only (Recommended)** - Back leaves the editor with no dialog. The sidebar, top nav and header back arrow are guarded. Next 16 has no public way to block Back; I would note this in the PR as a known limit.
- **Yes, guard Back too** - Push a guard entry into history and catch popstate. Next 16 reloads the page for history entries without its private __NA state (app-router.js:284-291), so this copies Next internals. It adds risk and code. I would suggest a separate issue.

**Should closing the tab or reloading the page also warn, with the browser's own prompt?**

Options:
- **Yes, native prompt (Recommended)** - Add a beforeunload listener while the form is dirty. The browser shows its own fixed text ("Leave site? Changes may not be saved"). It cannot offer Save. About 5 lines.
- **No, links only** - Keep strictly to the acceptance criteria. Close and reload lose edits with no warning, as today.

**Which copy should the dialog use? The buttons stay "Save" and "Don't save and leave" as the issue says.**

Options:
- **Plain** - Title: "Unsaved changes". Body: "You have unsaved changes to this event type. Do you want to save them before you leave?"
- **Warm** - Title: "Save your changes?". Body: "You made changes to this event type that are not saved yet. Save them before you go, or they will be lost."
- **Terse** - Title: "Leave without saving?". Body: "Your changes to this event type will be lost."

**The header back arrow is a button that calls router.push inside the shared Shell.tsx, so a link guard cannot see it. How should I catch it?**

Options:
- **Shell arrow becomes a link (Recommended)** - In Shell.tsx, a string backPath renders <Button href> (an <a>) instead of onClick router.push. One guard then covers sidebar, top nav and arrow. 13 pages get a link-style arrow: same target, middle-click now opens a tab. About 3 lines.
- **New optional Shell prop** - Add an optional onBackClick to Shell's LayoutProps that the editor sets. Other pages do not change. The editor then calls its guard before router.push.
- **Leave the arrow unguarded** - Only sidebar and top-nav links show the dialog. The back arrow still discards edits. This does not fully meet acceptance criterion 1 ("sidebar or header").


**Answer:** No, links only (Recommended), Yes, native prompt (Recommended), Plain, Shell arrow becomes a link (Recommended)
</details></tool-use>

```typescript
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

type LinkClick = Pick<
  MouseEvent,
  "target" | "button" | "defaultPrevented" | "metaKey" | "ctrlKey" | "shiftKey" | "altKey"
>;

function getBlockedLinkHref(event: LinkClick, location: Location): string | null {
  if (event.defaultPrevented || event.button !== 0) return null;
  // Modified clicks open a new tab or window, so this page and its edits stay open.
  if (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return null;
  if (!(event.target instanceof Element)) return null;

  const link = event.target.closest("a[href]");
  const href = link?.getAttribute("href");
  if (!link || !href) return null;

  const target = link.getAttribute("target");
  if ((target && target !== "_self") || link.hasAttribute("download")) return null;

  const destination = new URL(href, location.href);
  // Links to other sites unload the page, so the beforeunload prompt covers them.
  if (destination.origin !== location.origin) return null;
  // The editor's tabs only change ?tabName= on the same page, which keeps the form state.
  if (destination.pathname === location.pathname) return null;

  return `${destination.pathname}${destination.search}${destination.hash}`;
}

export function useUnsavedChangesGuard({
  hasUnsavedChanges,
  navigate,
  save,
}: {
  hasUnsavedChanges: boolean;
  navigate: (href: string) => void;
  save: () => Promise<boolean>;
}) {
  const [blockedHref, setBlockedHref] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const isLeavingRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasUnsavedChanges) return;

    const blockLinkClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (isLeavingRef.current) return;
      const href = getBlockedLinkHref(event, window.location);
      if (!href) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      setBlockedHref(href);
    };
    const warnBeforeUnload = (event: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
      if (isLeavingRef.current) return;
      event.preventDefault();
    };

    // Capture phase on document runs before next/link's own click handler, so the
    // navigation can be stopped before it starts.
    document.addEventListener("click", blockLinkClick, true);
    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", warnBeforeUnload);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("click", blockLinkClick, true);
      window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", warnBeforeUnload);
    };
  }, [hasUnsavedChanges]);

  const leave = (href: string) => {
    // The page stays mounted until the next route renders; without this, a second click
    // in that window would reopen the dialog.
    isLeavingRef.current = true;
    navigate(href);
  };

  const stay = () => setBlockedHref(null);

  const discardAndLeave = () => {
    if (!blockedHref) return;
    setBlockedHref(null);
    leave(blockedHref);
  };

  const saveAndLeave = async () => {
    if (!blockedHref) return;
    const href = blockedHref;
    setBlockedHref(null);
    const saved = await save();
    if (saved) leave(href);
  };

  return { blockedHref, stay, discardAndLeave, saveAndLeave };
}

```

```typescript
import { Dialog } from "@calcom/features/components/controlled-dialog";
import { useLocale } from "@calcom/lib/hooks/useLocale";
import { Button } from "@calcom/ui/components/button";
import { DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogFooter } from "@calcom/ui/components/dialog";

type UnsavedChangesDialogProps = {
  open: boolean;
  onStay: () => void;
  onDiscardAndLeave: () => void;
  onSaveAndLeave: () => void;
};

export function UnsavedChangesDialog({
  open,
  onStay,
  onDiscardAndLeave,
  onSaveAndLeave,
}: UnsavedChangesDialogProps) {
  const { t } = useLocale();

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(isOpen) => {
        if (!isOpen) onStay();
      }}>
      <DialogContent
        title={t("unsaved_changes")}
        description={t("unsaved_changes_event_type_description")}
        Icon="circle-alert"
        type="confirmation">
        <DialogClose variant="icon" StartIcon="x" className="absolute top-4 ltr:right-4 rtl:left-4">
          <span className="sr-only">{t("close")}</span>
        </DialogClose>
        <DialogFooter className="mt-6">
          <Button color="minimal" data-testid="unsaved-changes-discard" onClick={onDiscardAndLeave}>
            {t("dont_save_and_leave")}
          </Button>
          <Button data-testid="unsaved-changes-save" onClick={onSaveAndLeave}>
            {t("save")}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

```text
  "version": "16.0.1",
4
"use client";

import { ReadonlyURLSearchParams, useParams, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";

export const useCompatSearchParams = () => {
  const _searchParams = useSearchParams() ?? new URLSearchParams();
  const params = useParams() ?? {};

  const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(_searchParams.toString());
  Object.getOwnPropertyNames(params).forEach((key) => {
    searchParams.delete(key);

    // Though useParams is supposed to return a string/string[] as the key's value but it is found to return undefined as well.
    // Maybe it happens for pages dir when using optional catch-all routes.
    const param = params[key] || "";
    const paramArr = typeof param === "string" ? param.split("/") : param;

    paramArr.forEach((p) => {
      searchParams.append(key, p);
    });
  });

  return new ReadonlyURLSearchParams(searchParams);
};
import { useAtomsContext } from "./useAtomsContext";

export const useIsPlatform = () => {
  const context = useAtomsContext();
  return Boolean(context?.clientId);
};
```

```text
/**
 * Converts unknown error types to Error objects.
 *
 * @deprecated For server-side code, use `getServerErrorFromUnknown` from `@calcom/lib/server/getServerErrorFromUnknown` instead.
 * This function should only be used in client-side or isomorphic code (React components, shared utilities).
 *
 * Use this function when:
 * - You're in a React component that runs on the client
 * - You're in shared/isomorphic code that cannot import server-only dependencies
 * - You only need a basic Error object without HTTP status code mapping
 *
 * For server-side error handling (API routes, tRPC handlers, webhooks), use `getServerErrorFromUnknown`
 * which provides proper HTTP status code mapping, error redaction, and handles Zod/Prisma/Stripe errors.
 *
 * @param cause - The unknown error to convert
 * @returns An Error object with optional statusCode and code properties
 */
export function getErrorFromUnknown(cause: unknown): Error & { statusCode?: number; code?: string } {
  if (cause instanceof Error) {
    return cause;
  }
  if (typeof cause === "string") {
    // @ts-ignore https://github.com/tc39/proposal-error-cause - must use @ts-ignore because different packages have different TS lib targets
    return new Error(cause, { cause });
  }

  return new Error(`Unhandled error of type '${typeof cause}''`);
}
```

```typescript
import { act, renderHook } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { useUnsavedChangesGuard } from "./useUnsavedChangesGuard";

const EDITOR_PATH = "/event-types/12";

function addLink(href: string, attributes: Record<string, string> = {}) {
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.setAttribute("href", href);
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(attributes)) {
    link.setAttribute(name, value);
  }
  link.innerHTML = "<span>Bookings</span>";
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  return link;
}

// The listener on the link stands in for next/link: if the click reaches it, the app would
// navigate. It also stops jsdom from attempting a real navigation.
function click(element: Element, init: MouseEventInit = {}) {
  let reachedLink = false;
  const link = element.closest("a");
  const handleLinkClick = (event: Event) => {
    reachedLink = true;
    event.preventDefault();
  };
  link?.addEventListener("click", handleLinkClick);
  act(() => {
    element.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("click", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0, ...init }));
  });
  link?.removeEventListener("click", handleLinkClick);
  return { reachedLink };
}

function fireBeforeUnload() {
  const event = new Event("beforeunload", { cancelable: true });
  window.dispatchEvent(event);
  return event;
}

function renderGuard({
  hasUnsavedChanges = true,
  saveResult = true,
}: { hasUnsavedChanges?: boolean; saveResult?: boolean } = {}) {
  const visited: string[] = [];
  let saveCount = 0;
  const hook = renderHook((props) => useUnsavedChangesGuard(props), {
    initialProps: {
      hasUnsavedChanges,
      navigate: (href: string) => {
        visited.push(href);
      },
      save: async () => {
        saveCount += 1;
        return saveResult;
      },
    },
  });
  return { ...hook, visited, getSaveCount: () => saveCount };
}

describe("useUnsavedChangesGuard", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    window.history.replaceState({}, "", `${EDITOR_PATH}?tabName=setup`);
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    document.body.innerHTML = "";
  });

  describe("with unsaved changes", () => {
    it("stops a sidebar link to another page and remembers where it was going", () => {
      const { result } = renderGuard();

      const { reachedLink } = click(addLink("/bookings/upcoming"));

      expect(reachedLink).toBe(false);
      expect(result.current.blockedHref).toBe("/bookings/upcoming");
    });

    it("stops a click on the icon or label inside a link", () => {
      const { result } = renderGuard();
      const link = addLink("/availability");

      const { reachedLink } = click(link.querySelector("span") as Element);

      expect(reachedLink).toBe(false);
      expect(result.current.blockedHref).toBe("/availability");
    });

    it("keeps the query string of the destination, as the header back arrow uses one", () => {
      const { result } = renderGuard();

      click(addLink("/event-types?teamId=5"));

      expect(result.current.blockedHref).toBe("/event-types?teamId=5");
    });

    it("lets the editor's own tabs through, because they stay on the same page", () => {
      const { result } = renderGuard();

      const { reachedLink } = click(addLink(`${EDITOR_PATH}?tabName=limits`));

      expect(reachedLink).toBe(true);
      expect(result.current.blockedHref).toBeNull();
    });

    it.each([
      ["Cmd-click", { metaKey: true }],
      ["Ctrl-click", { ctrlKey: true }],
      ["Shift-click", { shiftKey: true }],
      ["a middle-click", { button: 1 }],
    ])("lets %s through, since it opens a new tab and this page stays open", (_name, init) => {
      const { result } = renderGuard();

      const { reachedLink } = click(addLink("/bookings/upcoming"), init);

      expect(reachedLink).toBe(true);
      expect(result.current.blockedHref).toBeNull();
    });

    it("lets a link with target _blank through, since this page stays open", () => {
      const { result } = renderGuard();

      const { reachedLink } = click(addLink("/bookings/upcoming", { target: "_blank" }));

      expect(reachedLink).toBe(true);
      expect(result.current.blockedHref).toBeNull();
    });

    it("leaves links to other sites to the browser's own leave-page prompt", () => {
      const { result } = renderGuard();

      const { reachedLink } = click(addLink("https://example.com/docs"));

      expect(reachedLink).toBe(true);
      expect(result.current.blockedHref).toBeNull();
      expect(fireBeforeUnload().defaultPrevented).toBe(true);
    });

    it("asks the browser to confirm before the tab is closed or reloaded", () => {
      renderGuard();

      expect(fireBeforeUnload().defaultPrevented).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe("without unsaved changes", () => {
    it("lets every link through and never shows the dialog", () => {
      const { result } = renderGuard({ hasUnsavedChanges: false });

      const { reachedLink } = click(addLink("/bookings/upcoming"));

      expect(reachedLink).toBe(true);
      expect(result.current.blockedHref).toBeNull();
    });

    it("lets the tab close or reload without a prompt", () => {
      renderGuard({ hasUnsavedChanges: false });

      expect(fireBeforeUnload().defaultPrevented).toBe(false);
    });

    it("stops guarding once the changes are saved from the header", () => {
      const { result, rerender } = renderGuard();

      rerender({ ...renderGuardProps(), hasUnsavedChanges: false });
      const { reachedLink } = click(addLink("/bookings/upcoming"));

      expect(reachedLink).toBe(true);
      expect(result.current.blockedHref).toBeNull();
      expect(fireBeforeUnload().defaultPrevented).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe("after a link was stopped", () => {
    it("stays on the page with the edits kept when the dialog is dismissed", () => {
      const { result, visited, getSaveCount } = renderGuard();
      click(addLink("/bookings/upcoming"));

      act(() => result.current.stay());

      expect(result.current.blockedHref).toBeNull();
      expect(visited).toEqual([]);
      expect(getSaveCount()).toBe(0);
      expect(click(addLink("/availability")).reachedLink).toBe(false);
    });

    it("goes to the clicked destination without saving on Don't save and leave", () => {
      const { result, visited, getSaveCount } = renderGuard();
      click(addLink("/bookings/upcoming"));

      act(() => result.current.discardAndLeave());

      expect(visited).toEqual(["/bookings/upcoming"]);
      expect(getSaveCount()).toBe(0);
    });

    it("saves first, then goes to the clicked destination when the save succeeds", async () => {
      const { result, visited, getSaveCount } = renderGuard({ saveResult: true });
      click(addLink("/bookings/upcoming"));

      await act(() => result.current.saveAndLeave());

      expect(getSaveCount()).toBe(1);
      expect(visited).toEqual(["/bookings/upcoming"]);
    });

    it("stays on the page when the save fails", async () => {
      const { result, visited, getSaveCount } = renderGuard({ saveResult: false });
      click(addLink("/bookings/upcoming"));

      await act(() => result.current.saveAndLeave());

      expect(getSaveCount()).toBe(1);
      expect(visited).toEqual([]);
      expect(result.current.blockedHref).toBeNull();
      expect(click(addLink("/availability")).reachedLink).toBe(false);
    });

    it("does not stop further clicks or the unload while it is already leaving", () => {
      const { result } = renderGuard();
      click(addLink("/bookings/upcoming"));

      act(() => result.current.discardAndLeave());

      expect(click(addLink("/availability")).reachedLink).toBe(true);
      expect(result.current.blockedHref).toBeNull();
      expect(fireBeforeUnload().defaultPrevented).toBe(false);
    });
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { fireEvent, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { UnsavedChangesDialog } from "./UnsavedChangesDialog";

vi.mock("@calcom/lib/hooks/useLocale", () => ({
  useLocale: () => ({ t: (key: string) => key }),
}));

vi.mock("@calcom/lib/hooks/useCompatSearchParams", () => ({
  useCompatSearchParams: () => new URLSearchParams(),
}));

function renderDialog({ open = true }: { open?: boolean } = {}) {
  const handlers = {
    onStay: vi.fn(),
    onDiscardAndLeave: vi.fn(),
    onSaveAndLeave: vi.fn(),
  };
  render(<UnsavedChangesDialog open={open} {...handlers} />);
  return handlers;
}

describe("UnsavedChangesDialog", () => {
  it("warns about unsaved changes and offers Save and Don't save and leave", () => {
    renderDialog();

    expect(screen.getByText("unsaved_changes")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("unsaved_changes_event_type_description")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "save" })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "dont_save_and_leave" })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("shows nothing while no navigation is blocked", () => {
    renderDialog({ open: false });

    expect(screen.queryByText("unsaved_changes")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("closes on Escape and keeps the user on the page, without saving or leaving", () => {
    const { onStay, onDiscardAndLeave, onSaveAndLeave } = renderDialog();

    fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByRole("dialog"), { key: "Escape" });

    expect(onStay).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(onDiscardAndLeave).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(onSaveAndLeave).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("closes on the close button and keeps the user on the page, without saving or leaving", () => {
    const { onStay, onDiscardAndLeave, onSaveAndLeave } = renderDialog();

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "close" }));

    expect(onStay).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(onDiscardAndLeave).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(onSaveAndLeave).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("leaves without saving on Don't save and leave", () => {
    const { onStay, onDiscardAndLeave, onSaveAndLeave } = renderDialog();

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "dont_save_and_leave" }));

    expect(onDiscardAndLeave).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(onSaveAndLeave).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(onStay).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("saves and leaves on Save", () => {
    const { onStay, onDiscardAndLeave, onSaveAndLeave } = renderDialog();

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "save" }));

    expect(onSaveAndLeave).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(onDiscardAndLeave).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(onStay).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

```cjs
// Walks issue #9's acceptance criteria against the local dev server and saves screenshots.
// Usage: node issue9-walk.cjs <baseUrl> <outDir>
const { createRequire } = require("node:module");
const path = require("node:path");
const fs = require("node:fs");

const WORKTREE = "/Users/zachshort/Projects/cal.diy/.claude/worktrees/issue-9";
const { chromium } = createRequire(path.join(WORKTREE, "package.json"))("@playwright/test");

const BASE = process.argv[2] || "http://localhost:3000";
const OUT = process.argv[3] || __dirname;
const EDITOR = `${BASE}/event-types/12?tabName=setup`;
const ORIGINAL_TITLE = "Tennis class";
const results = [];

function check(name, ok, detail = "") {
  results.push({ name, ok, detail });
  console.log(`${ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL"}  ${name}${detail ? `  (${detail})` : ""}`);
}

async function main() {
  fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ channel: "chrome", headless: true });
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2 });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog").filter({ hasText: "Unsaved changes" });
  const sidebar = (href) => page.locator(`a[href="${href}"]:visible`).first();
  const title = page.locator('input[name="title"]');
  const shot = (name) => page.screenshot({ path: path.join(OUT, `${name}.png`) });

  // Seeded local test user from `yarn db-seed` (agents/rules/reference-local-dev.md).
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/auth/login`);
  await page.locator('input[name="email"]').fill("pro@example.com");
  await page.locator('input[name="password"]').fill("pro");
  await page.locator('button[type="submit"]').click();
  await page.waitForURL((url) => !url.pathname.startsWith("/auth/login"), { timeout: 60000 });

  const openEditor = async () => {
    await page.goto(EDITOR);
    await title.waitFor({ timeout: 120000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
  };

  // AC2: no edits, every tab visited, then a sidebar link goes straight through.
  await openEditor();
  for (const tab of ["availability", "limits", "advanced", "recurring", "apps", "webhooks", "setup"]) {
    await page.goto(`${BASE}/event-types/12?tabName=${tab}`);
    await page.waitForTimeout(2500);
  }
  const saveDisabled = await page.locator('[data-testid="update-eventtype"]:visible').isDisabled();
  check("AC2 untouched form after visiting every tab: Save greyed", saveDisabled);
  await sidebar("/availability").click();
  await page.waitForURL("**/availability", { timeout: 60000 });
  check("AC2 untouched form: sidebar link navigates with no dialog", (await dialog.count()) === 0);

  // AC2 header arrow: it is now a link and goes straight through when clean.
  await openEditor();
  const back = page.locator('[data-testid="go-back-button"]:visible').first();
  check("Header back arrow renders as a link", (await back.evaluate((el) => el.tagName)) === "A");
  await back.click();
  await page.waitForURL((url) => url.pathname === "/event-types", { timeout: 60000 });
  check("AC2 untouched form: header back arrow navigates with no dialog", true);

  // AC1 + AC5: an edit, then a sidebar link opens the dialog and stays put.
  await openEditor();
  await title.fill(`${ORIGINAL_TITLE} (edited)`);
  await sidebar("/bookings/upcoming").click();
  await dialog.waitFor({ timeout: 10000 });
  check("AC1 sidebar link with edits: dialog opens", await dialog.isVisible());
  check("AC1 sidebar link with edits: URL unchanged", page.url().includes("/event-types/12"));
  await page.waitForTimeout(400);
  await shot("issue-9-dialog-from-sidebar");

  await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
  await dialog.waitFor({ state: "detached", timeout: 10000 });
  check("AC5 Escape: dialog closes, still on editor", page.url().includes("/event-types/12"));
  check("AC5 Escape: edit kept", (await title.inputValue()) === `${ORIGINAL_TITLE} (edited)`);

  await page.locator('[data-testid="go-back-button"]:visible').first().click();
  await dialog.waitFor({ timeout: 10000 });
  check("AC1 header back arrow with edits: dialog opens", await dialog.isVisible());
  await page.waitForTimeout(400);
  await shot("issue-9-dialog-from-back-arrow");
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Close" }).click();
  await dialog.waitFor({ state: "detached", timeout: 10000 });
  check("AC5 close button: dialog closes, still on editor", page.url().includes("/event-types/12"));
  check("AC5 close button: edit kept", (await title.inputValue()) === `${ORIGINAL_TITLE} (edited)`);

  // Editor tabs are the same page: switching tabs with edits shows no dialog.
  await page.locator('a[href*="tabName=limits"]:visible').first().click();
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
  check("Tab switch with edits: no dialog", (await dialog.count()) === 0 && page.url().includes("tabName=limits"));
  await page.locator('a[href*="tabName=setup"]:visible').first().click();
  await title.waitFor();

  // Tab close / reload: the browser's own prompt.
  const beforeUnload = new Promise((resolve) => {
    page.once("dialog", async (d) => {
      resolve(d.type());
      await d.dismiss();
    });
    setTimeout(() => resolve("none"), 5000);
  });
  await page.close({ runBeforeUnload: true });
  const unloadType = await beforeUnload;
  check("Tab close with edits: browser beforeunload prompt", unloadType === "beforeunload", unloadType);
  const page2 = page.isClosed() ? await context.newPage() : page;

  // AC3: Don't save and leave.
  const p = page2;
  const dialog2 = p.getByRole("dialog").filter({ hasText: "Unsaved changes" });
  const title2 = p.locator('input[name="title"]');
  const sidebar2 = (href) => p.locator(`a[href="${href}"]:visible`).first();
  const openEditor2 = async () => {
    await p.goto(EDITOR);
    await title2.waitFor({ timeout: 120000 });
    await p.waitForTimeout(1500);
  };
  await openEditor2();
  await title2.fill(`${ORIGINAL_TITLE} (discarded)`);
  await sidebar2("/availability").click();
  await dialog2.waitFor();
  await p.locator('[data-testid="unsaved-changes-discard"]').click();
  await p.waitForURL("**/availability", { timeout: 60000 });
  check("AC3 Don't save and leave: goes to clicked destination", true);
  await openEditor2();
  check("AC3 Don't save and leave: edit was not saved", (await title2.inputValue()) === ORIGINAL_TITLE);

  // AC4 failure: a slug that already exists makes the server reject the save.
  const slug = p.locator('input[name="slug"]');
  await slug.fill("30min");
  await sidebar2("/availability").click();
  await dialog2.waitFor();
  await p.locator('[data-testid="unsaved-changes-save"]').click();
  const errorToast = p.locator('[data-testid="toast-error"]').first();
  await errorToast.waitFor({ timeout: 30000 });
  check("AC4 save fails: error message shown", await errorToast.isVisible(), await errorToast.innerText());
  check("AC4 save fails: still on editor", p.url().includes("/event-types/12"));
  check("AC4 save fails: edit kept", (await slug.inputValue()) === "30min");
  await p.waitForTimeout(300);
  await p.screenshot({ path: path.join(OUT, "issue-9-save-failed.png") });
  await slug.fill("tennis-class");

  // AC4 success: Save from the dialog saves, then goes to the destination.
  await openEditor2();
  await title2.fill(`${ORIGINAL_TITLE} (saved)`);
  await sidebar2("/availability").click();
  await dialog2.waitFor();
  await p.locator('[data-testid="unsaved-changes-save"]').click();
  await p.waitForURL("**/availability", { timeout: 60000 });
  check("AC4 save succeeds: goes to clicked destination", true);
  await openEditor2();
  check("AC4 save succeeds: edit was saved", (await title2.inputValue()) === `${ORIGINAL_TITLE} (saved)`);

  // Restore the seed title through the normal header Save, then confirm AC2's after-save case.
  await title2.fill(ORIGINAL_TITLE);
  await p.locator('[data-testid="update-eventtype"]:visible').click();
  await p.locator('[data-testid="toast-success"]').first().waitFor({ timeout: 30000 });
  await p.waitForTimeout(1000);
  await sidebar2("/availability").click();
  await p.waitForURL("**/availability", { timeout: 60000 });
  check("AC2 after a header save: sidebar link navigates with no dialog", (await dialog2.count()) === 0);

  // Known limit, by decision: browser Back is not guarded.
  await openEditor2();
  await title2.fill(`${ORIGINAL_TITLE} (back)`);
  await p.goBack();
  await p.waitForTimeout(3000);
  check("Browser Back (not guarded, by decision): leaves without the dialog", !p.url().includes("/event-types/12") || (await dialog2.count()) === 0, p.url());

  await browser.close();
  const failed = results.filter((r) => !r.ok);
  console.log(`\n${results.length - failed.length}/${results.length} checks passed`);
  process.exit(failed.length ? 1 : 0);
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  process.exit(2);
});
```

```text
# PR draft — issue #10 (save button enabled with no changes)

**Status: NOT OPENED.** `zach-short` has `pull` only on `CSCI-435-SE/cal.diy` (HANDOFF §Settled),
so the branch cannot be pushed. Park here until write access lands, then open as a **draft PR**
(`agents/rules/quality-pr-creation.md`).

- **Branch:** `fix/issue-10-save-button-no-changes` (off `origin/main`)
- **Title:** `fix: stop the description editor marking an untouched event type as changed (#10)`
- **Base:** `main`
- **Labels:** none are available to him; ask a maintainer for `run-ci` if CI is wanted.

---

## What does this PR do?

- Fixes #10

Opening an event type for editing left **Save** enabled even though nothing had been touched, and
pressing it wrote a corrupted description back to the database.

The Save button was never the problem. It already guards itself with
`disabled={!formMethods.formState.isDirty}` (`EventTypeLayout.tsx:279`), and that guard works — the
form was genuinely dirty on load.

**Root cause.** The Lexical editor behind the description field calls `setText` twice while it
mounts (measured on a running app: two emissions ~48ms apart, identical), echoing back the value it
was just seeded with. `EventSetupTab` wrote that echo into the form with `{ shouldDirty: true }`.
Because the `md.render` -> `turndown` round-trip is lossy, the echoed value often differs from what
is stored, so react-hook-form correctly concluded the form had changed:

| stored description | value in the form after mount, before this PR |
|---|---|
| `NULL` | `""` |
| `**bold** and _italic_` | `****bold**** and _italic_` |

That second row is the part the issue does not mention: `handleSubmit` builds its payload from
`dirtyValues` (`useEventTypeForm.ts:320`, `:410`), so `description` *was* in the payload. Saving an
event type you had not edited silently doubled the asterisks in its description.

**The fix.** Two changes:

1. `apps/web/modules/event-types/components/tabs/setup/description-editor-guard.ts` (new) — a small
   guard that answers one question per emission: is this the user editing, or the editor echoing
   its own seed value? It remembers the first emitted value, treats anything equal to it as an echo,
   and latches on the first differing value so every later emission is an edit. The latch matters:
   without it, clearing the description back to the echoed text would be silently dropped.
2. `useEventTypeForm.ts` — `description: eventType.description ?? undefined` becomes `?? ""`. With
   the default no longer `undefined`, emptying the description of an event type that never had one
   returns the form to genuinely clean rather than leaving it dirty against `undefined`.

**Known limitation, deliberately out of scope.** "Edit the description, then edit it back, and the
button greys out again" is not achievable while the markdown round-trip stays lossy — `- a` / `- b`
comes back as `*   a` / `*   b`, and a hard line break comes back as `<br>`. That lossiness is a
separate defect and deserves its own issue; this PR stops it dirtying an untouched form and stops
it reaching the database on a no-op save.
```

```cjs
// Records console errors/warnings and page errors on the event type editor, with and without the guard firing.
const { createRequire } = require("node:module");
const path = require("node:path");

const WORKTREE = "/Users/zachshort/Projects/cal.diy/.claude/worktrees/issue-9";
const { chromium } = createRequire(path.join(WORKTREE, "package.json"))("@playwright/test");
const BASE = process.argv[2] || "http://localhost:3000";

async function main() {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ channel: "chrome", headless: true });
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, timezoneId: "Europe/London" });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  let phase = "login";
  const seen = [];
  page.on("console", (msg) => {
    if (msg.type() === "error" || msg.type() === "warning") seen.push(`[${phase}] ${msg.type()}: ${msg.text().slice(0, 300)}`);
  });
  page.on("pageerror", (err) => seen.push(`[${phase}] pageerror: ${String(err).slice(0, 300)}`));

  await page.goto(`${BASE}/auth/login`);
  await page.locator('input[name="email"]').fill("pro@example.com");
  await page.locator('input[name="password"]').fill("pro");
  await page.locator('button[type="submit"]').click();
  await page.waitForURL((url) => !url.pathname.startsWith("/auth/login"), { timeout: 60000 });

  phase = "editor-load";
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/event-types/12?tabName=setup`);
  await page.locator('input[name="title"]').waitFor({ timeout: 120000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(3000);

  phase = "guard";
  await page.locator('input[name="title"]').fill("Tennis class (edited)");
  await page.locator('a[href="/availability"]:visible').first().click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog").filter({ hasText: "Unsaved changes" });
  await dialog.waitFor();
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
  await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);

  console.log(seen.length ? seen.join("\n") : "no console errors or warnings");
  await browser.close();
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  process.exit(2);
});

```

```cjs
// Records a short demo video of issue #9 and re-takes the stills with the dev-only overlay hidden.
// Usage: node issue9-demo.cjs <baseUrl> <outDir>
const { createRequire } = require("node:module");
const path = require("node:path");
const fs = require("node:fs");

const WORKTREE = "/Users/zachshort/Projects/cal.diy/.claude/worktrees/issue-9";
const { chromium } = createRequire(path.join(WORKTREE, "package.json"))("@playwright/test");

const BASE = process.argv[2] || "http://localhost:3000";
const OUT = process.argv[3] || __dirname;
const EDITOR = `${BASE}/event-types/12?tabName=setup`;
const ORIGINAL_TITLE = "Tennis class";
// The Next.js dev overlay badge counts pre-existing dev warnings; it never ships to production.
const HIDE_DEV_OVERLAY = "nextjs-portal { display: none !important; }";
const VIEWPORT = { width: 1440, height: 900 };

async function login(browser) {
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: VIEWPORT, timezoneId: "Europe/London" });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  // Seeded local test user from `yarn db-seed` (agents/rules/reference-local-dev.md).
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/auth/login`);
  await page.locator('input[name="email"]').fill("pro@example.com");
  await page.locator('input[name="password"]').fill("pro");
  await page.locator('button[type="submit"]').click();
  await page.waitForURL((url) => !url.pathname.startsWith("/auth/login"), { timeout: 60000 });
  const state = await context.storageState();
  await context.close();
  return state;
}

async function openEditor(page) {
  await page.goto(EDITOR);
  await page.locator('input[name="title"]').waitFor({ timeout: 120000 });
  await page.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE_DEV_OVERLAY });
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
}

async function main() {
  fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ channel: "chrome", headless: true });
  const storageState = await login(browser);

  const videoDir = path.join(OUT, "video-raw");
  const context = await browser.newContext({
    viewport: VIEWPORT,
    timezoneId: "Europe/London",
    storageState,
    recordVideo: { dir: videoDir, size: VIEWPORT },
  });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  const title = page.locator('input[name="title"]');
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog").filter({ hasText: "Unsaved changes" });
  const sidebar = (href) => page.locator(`a[href="${href}"]:visible`).first();

  // 1. No edits: the sidebar link goes straight through.
  await openEditor(page);
  await sidebar("/availability").hover();
  await page.waitForTimeout(800);
  await sidebar("/availability").click();
  await page.waitForURL("**/availability");
  await page.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE_DEV_OVERLAY });
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);

  // 2. Edit, click a sidebar link: the dialog opens; Escape keeps the edit.
  await openEditor(page);
  await title.click();
  await page.keyboard.press("End");
  await page.keyboard.type(" (edited)", { delay: 90 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(600);
  await sidebar("/bookings/upcoming").hover();
  await page.waitForTimeout(600);
  await sidebar("/bookings/upcoming").click();
  await dialog.waitFor();
  await page.waitForTimeout(400);
  await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(OUT, "issue-9-dialog-from-sidebar.png") });
  await page.waitForTimeout(1800);
  await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
  await dialog.waitFor({ state: "detached" });
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);

  // 3. The header back arrow is guarded too; Save saves, then leaves.
  const back = page.locator('[data-testid="go-back-button"]:visible').first();
  await back.hover();
  await page.waitForTimeout(600);
  await back.click();
  await dialog.waitFor();
  await page.waitForTimeout(400);
  await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(OUT, "issue-9-dialog-from-back-arrow.png") });
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
  await page.locator('[data-testid="unsaved-changes-save"]').hover();
  await page.waitForTimeout(600);
  await page.locator('[data-testid="unsaved-changes-save"]').click();
  await page.waitForURL((url) => url.pathname === "/event-types", { timeout: 60000 });
  await page.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE_DEV_OVERLAY });
  await page.waitForTimeout(3000);

  await context.close();
  const [raw] = fs.readdirSync(videoDir).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".webm"));
  fs.renameSync(path.join(videoDir, raw), path.join(OUT, "issue-9-demo.webm"));
  fs.rmSync(videoDir, { recursive: true });

  // 4. Save failure still: a duplicate slug is rejected by the server. Not recorded.
  const still = await browser.newContext({ viewport: VIEWPORT, timezoneId: "Europe/London", storageState, deviceScaleFactor: 2 });
  const p = await still.newPage();
  await openEditor(p);
  const pTitle = p.locator('input[name="title"]');
  if ((await pTitle.inputValue()) !== ORIGINAL_TITLE) {
    // Put the seed title back through the app's own Save, which also revalidates the page cache.
    await pTitle.fill(ORIGINAL_TITLE);
    await p.locator('[data-testid="update-eventtype"]:visible').click();
    await p.locator('[data-testid="toast-success"]').first().waitFor({ timeout: 30000 });
    await openEditor(p);
  }
  await p.locator('input[name="slug"]').fill("30min");
  await p.locator('a[href="/availability"]:visible').first().click();
  await p.getByRole("dialog").filter({ hasText: "Unsaved changes" }).waitFor();
  await p.locator('[data-testid="unsaved-changes-save"]').click();
  await p.locator('[data-testid="toast-error"]').first().waitFor({ timeout: 30000 });
  await p.waitForTimeout(400);
  await p.screenshot({ path: path.join(OUT, "issue-9-save-failed.png") });
  console.log("final title:", await pTitle.inputValue(), "| url:", p.url());

  await browser.close();
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  process.exit(2);
});

```

```markdown
## What does this PR do?

- Fixes #9

Leaving the event type editor with unsaved edits used to throw them away without a word. Now a
click on any link that leaves the editor (the sidebar, the top navigation, or the back arrow in the
header) opens a dialog first. "Save" saves and then goes where the user clicked. "Don't save and
leave" goes there without saving. Escape or the close button keeps the user on the page with the
edits intact. With no edits, or right after a save, links work as before and no dialog appears.

"Has unsaved edits" is the same signal that enables the header Save button,
`formMethods.formState.isDirty` (`EventTypeLayout.tsx:279`). Issue #10 (#20) made that signal
trustworthy on load, so the dialog and the Save button always agree.

**How it works.** The App Router has no API for blocking a navigation, and the editor's existing
`useHandleRouteChange` hook only runs after the pathname has already changed. So the new
`useUnsavedChangesGuard` hook listens for link clicks on `document` in the capture phase while the
form is dirty. That listener runs before `next/link`'s own handler, which returns early when the
event is already `defaultPrevented` (`next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js:319` in Next 16.2.3). The
hook stops the click and remembers the destination; the dialog then decides what happens. It lets
a click through when the link opens a new tab (Cmd, Ctrl, Shift or middle click, or
`target="_blank"`), when it points to another site, and when it stays on the same page. The last
case covers the editor's own tabs, which only change `?tabName=` and keep the form state.

"Save" in the dialog runs the same submit path as the header Save button. It resolves to `true`
only when the update mutation succeeds. If the server rejects the save, the existing error toast
appears and the user stays on the page. If the form is invalid, the user also stays and sees
"Error updating settings".

**Two changes outside the editor, both small.**

1. `Shell.tsx`: when `backPath` is a string, the header back arrow is now a real link
   (`<Button href>`) instead of a button that calls `router.push`. A click listener cannot see
   where a button is going, so without this the editor could not guard its own back arrow. The
   destination is unchanged on every page that uses `backPath`. The visible difference is that
   the arrow can now be middle-clicked into a new tab. `backPath={true}` still calls
   `router.back()`.
2. Closing or reloading the tab with unsaved edits now shows the browser's own "Leave site?"
   prompt (`beforeunload`). The browser fixes its wording, and it cannot offer Save.

**Decided with the issue owner (2026-10-07).** The issue's open question, whether the browser Back
button should open the dialog, is answered **no**. Next 16 reloads the page on Back for any
history entry that lacks its private `__NA` state (`next/dist/client/components/app-router.js:284`),
so guarding Back means writing that private state ourselves. That is fragile across Next upgrades,
and it belongs in its own issue if anyone wants it.

**Known limits.** Browser Back is not guarded, as above. Navigation started from code rather than
from a link, such as the Cmd+K menu, is not guarded either, because it never passes through a link
click. Links to other sites fall to the browser's own prompt.

**Files.** New: `apps/web/modules/event-types/hooks/useUnsavedChangesGuard.ts` (+ test),
`apps/web/modules/event-types/components/dialogs/UnsavedChangesDialog.tsx` (+ test). Changed:
`EventTypeWebWrapper.tsx` (wiring), `Shell.tsx` (back arrow), `en/common.json` (3 strings). 493
lines of code, 301 of them tests.
```

```text
#!/bin/bash
# Prose-quality hook: blocks AI-signal writing in papers and documents.
#
# Modes:
#   post         PostToolUse on Write|Edit. Checks prose files.
#   bash         PostToolUse on Bash. Checks Word-type files (docx, doc, rtf, odt)
#                that the command created or changed in the last 3 minutes.
#   check FILE   Run the checks on one file by hand. Prints problems. Exit 1 if any.
#   stop         Checks the last chat reply. NOT wired in settings.json
#                (chat replies follow the STE rule only).
#
# Checks: em dash (U+2014), contractions, banned AI-signal words and phrases.
# Banned words are skipped for files under /.claude/ (rule files list them on purpose).
# Fenced code and inline code are ignored.
# Text files: .md .mdx .txt .rst .tex .adoc. Word-type files: .docx .doc .rtf .odt (need macOS textutil).
mode="$1"
dash="$(printf '\xe2\x80\x94')"

strip_code() { printf '%s' "$1" | perl -0pe 's/```.*?```//gs; s/`[^`\n]*`//g'; }

has_contraction() {
  strip_code "$1" \
    | grep -Eiq "[a-z]n('|’)t\b|[a-z]('|’)(re|ve|ll|m|d)\b|\b(it|that|there|here|what|let|he|she|who|where|how|when|why)('|’)s\b"
}

BANNED='\b(delv(e|es|ed|ing)|tapestry|pivotal|showcas(e|es|ed|ing)|underscor(e|es|ed|ing)|testament|nestled|meticulous(ly)?|intricate|intricacies|multifaceted|garner(s|ed|ing)?|elucidat(e|es|ed|ing)|bolster(s|ed|ing)?|fostering|crucial|moreover|furthermore|additionally|commendable|beacon|cornerstone|paradigm shift|game-changer|holistic|seamless(ly)?|invaluable|unparalleled|groundbreaking|ever-evolving|ever-changing)\b|in the realm of|stands as a|plays a (pivotal|crucial|vital|key|significant) role|in today.{1,3}s (fast-paced|digital|modern|world)|it is (important|worth) (to )?not(e|ing)|in conclusion|in summary|at the end of the day|i hope this helps|let me know if you|great question|as an ai (language )?model|knowledge cutoff|\bnot (just|only|merely)\b[^.!?]{0,100}\bbut\b'

banned_hits() {
  strip_code "$1" | grep -Eioh "$BANNED" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | sort -u | head -8 | paste -sd ',' - | sed 's/,/, /g'
}

# run_checks TEXT FILE : prints one problem per line. Returns 1 if any.
run_checks() {
  local text="$1" file="$2" bad=0 hits
  case "$text" in
    *"$dash"*)
      echo "Em dash found. Rewrite without the em dash. Use a period, comma, colon or parentheses."; bad=1 ;;
  esac
  if has_contraction "$text"; then
    echo "Contraction found. Rewrite without contractions. Write 'do not', 'it is', 'cannot'."; bad=1
  fi
  case "$file" in
    */.claude/*) ;;
    *)
      hits="$(banned_hits "$text")"
      if [ -n "$hits" ]; then
        echo "Banned AI-signal words or phrases found: $hits. State the fact plainly. See ~/.claude/rules/writing-style.md."; bad=1
      fi ;;
  esac
  return $bad
}

# gather_office_files CMD CWD : candidate Word-type files from the command text and recent files in CWD.
gather_office_files() {
  local cmd="$1" cwd="$2" t
  printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eio "[^[:space:]\"'\`;|&<>=()]+\.(docx|doc|rtf|odt)" | while read -r t; do
    if [ "${t#\~}" != "$t" ]; then t="$HOME${t#\~}"
    elif [ "${t#/}" = "$t" ]; then t="$cwd/$t"; fi
    printf '%s\n' "$t"
  done
```

```text
import { Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogFooter } from "@calcom/ui/components/dialog";

type UnsavedChangesDialogProps = {
  open: boolean;
  onStay: () => void;
  onDiscardAndLeave: () => void;
  onSaveAndLeave: () => void;
};

export function UnsavedChangesDialog({
  open,
  onStay,
  onDiscardAndLeave,
  onSaveAndLeave,
}: UnsavedChangesDialogProps) {
  const { t } = useLocale();

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(isOpen) => {
        if (!isOpen) onStay();
      }}>
      <DialogContent
        title={t("unsaved_changes")}
        description={t("unsaved_changes_event_type_description")}
        Icon="circle-alert"
        type="confirmation">
        <DialogClose variant="icon" StartIcon="x" className="absolute top-4 ltr:right-4 rtl:left-4">
          <span className="sr-only">{t("close")}</span>
        </DialogClose>
        <DialogFooter className="mt-6">
          <Button color="minimal" data-testid="unsaved-changes-discard" onClick={onDiscardAndLeave}>
```
